newsitem.title: USA: American Electromedics sees return to profit Q1'98.
newsitem.headline: American Electromedics sees return to profit Q1'98.

text.p: American Electromedics Corp said Wednesday it expects to return to profitability by its first fiscal quarter of 1998 ending October 31, 1997.
Michael Pieniazek, president, said the company expects this development after a "dramatic reduction" in losses in its fiscal fourth quarter 1997 ending July 31.
Pieniazek said the company anticipantes higher sales of its audiometric products in Germany and sales of its new medical camera system to reduce the losses.
Pieniazek said that previously, regulatory changes in Germany had hurt sales of its audiometric products, causing a drop in net sales and deep losses.
He said this changed after American Electromedics AMER.OB received a certification that its products met international standards for medical devices.
The company today reported a loss for the third quarter, ended April 26, of $0.21 a share on net sales of $423,000. A year earlier it earned $0.08 share on net sales of $1.1 million.
